title: An agreement open for one representative of a compatible fpqc datum
statement: Let $S$, $T_i$, $g_i$, $F$, and $s_i$ be as follows: $S$ is a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\{g_i:T_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ is an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], $F$ is a sheaf of sets on $S_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets, def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $s_i\in(g_i^{-1}F)(T_i)$ have equal double-overlap pullbacks under the unit-compatible composition isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units, def-pc-fibre-product]. Fix $i\in I$, an étale object $Z/T_i$ with its arrow $\pi:Z\to T_i$, an étale object $V/S$, a $T_i$-morphism $a:Z\to V\times_S T_i$, and $t\in F(V)$ such that $\pi^*s_i=a^*\eta_{g_i,V}(t)$. There exists an open $U\subset V$ containing the image of $Z\xrightarrow{a}V\times_ST_i\to V$, such that for $W=U$ considered as an étale object over $S$ and $b:W\to V$ its inclusion, $\eta_{g_j,W}(F(b)(t))$ equals the restriction of $s_j$ along $W\times_ST_j\to T_j$ for every $j$. This asserts neither a covering of $S$ nor compatibility of different local representatives.

proof.text: For each j take the largest agreement open in T_j times_S V for the unit image of t and the restriction of s_j. On each double overlap, the unit-compatible composition equations and the prescribed equality for s_j,s_k identify the two section pairs after the canonical fibre-product symmetry and associativity maps. The universal property of the largest agreement opens therefore identifies the pullback opens.

Use etale fpqc open descent to obtain U in V whose inverse images are these opens. On each base change of U the canonical inverse-image restrictions agree. The inverse-image stalk comparison with its unit formula reflects germ equality, so geometric-germ extensionality recovers equality of the two sections on that whole etale base change. Unit naturality gives the matching equation.

Apply inverse-image unit naturality to the morphisms a and pi and restrict along the diagonal over Z. The representing equation gives equality of the canonical inverse-image sections used in the agreement-open property. Thus a.left factors through the i-th agreement open. Since it is the inverse image of U, the projection of a.left to V has image contained in U.
